content: प्रद्योतः .²1 Irradiating, lighting, illuminating. .²2 Splendour, light, lustre. .²3 A ray of light. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of a king of Ujjayinī, whose daughter Vatsa married; प्रद्योतस्य प्रियदुहितरं वत्सराजोऽत्र जह्ने <ls>Me. 32</ls>. (considered as an interpolation by <ls>Malli.</ls>); <ls>Ratn. 1. 10</ls>.
